title: Folded Fan · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Folded Fan · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Give the lead one sheet of paper. The lead folds the sheet back and forth into an accordion fan without cutting. The folded sheet opens and closes as a fan. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: One sheet of paper.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Folded Fan, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The folded sheet opens and closes as a fan.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The folded sheet opens and closes as a fan.
